title: TrustmeWatcher: An Application for Workplace Micro-Sensing and Explainable Well-Being Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.06657v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Workplace sensing studies combine long-running behaviour traces with self-reports, yet the tools that collect those data often sit apart from the interface that returns results. We present TrustmeWatcher, the application built for the TRUST-ME project to connect this work. TrustmeWatcher reuses ActivityWatch's OS-level watchers for computer-activity collection and adds its own application layer. It turns the collected traces into an interactive screen-time dashboard, synchronizes responses from short questionnaires completed on the StreamDeck, and presents questionnaires alongside video highlights. Activity records and self-reports are aligned into labelled records for model development. The scope of this paper is limited to ActivityWatch data as model input. translated_title: TrustmeWatcher：一款用于职场微感知与可解释幸福感反馈的应用程序
translated_abstract: 职场感知研究通常将长期采集的行为记录与自我报告相结合，然而收集这些数据的工具往往与返回结果的界面相互分离。我们提出了 TrustmeWatcher，这是为 TRUST-ME 项目构建的一款应用程序，旨在打通这一工作流程。TrustmeWatcher 复用 ActivityWatch 的操作系统级监视器来采集计算机活动数据，并在此基础上添加了自身的应用层。它将采集到的行为记录转化为交互式屏幕使用时间仪表盘，同步用户在 StreamDeck 上完成的简短问卷的回答，并将问卷与视频亮点一并呈现。活动记录与自我报告被对齐为带标签的记录，用于模型开发。本文的范围仅限于将 ActivityWatch 数据作为模型输入。人工智能利用这些活动记录来预测六个归一化的状态分数和一个总体幸福感分数。训练好的模型在本地运行，仪表盘……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: TrustmeWatcher 是一款整合操作系统级活动感知数据与问卷自我报告、并借助本地运行的人工智能模型生成可解释幸福感反馈的职场微感知应用程序。
en_tdlr: TrustmeWatcher is a workplace micro-sensing application that integrates OS-level activity traces with questionnaire self-reports and delivers explainable well-being feedback through a locally running AI model.
